Save and read a masking plan as YAML

Source: R/plan.R
save_plan.Rd

A plan on disk can be read and compared as text. save_plan() needs the yaml package. A custom on_land function cannot be written, and is refused. A source-vocabulary plan names real columns and labels, so it stays with the owner. The analyst's file comes from clone_plan() or handover().

Usage

save_plan(plan, path)

read_plan(path)

Arguments

plan

A masque_plan().

path

Path of a .yaml or .yml file.

Value

save_plan() returns path invisibly; read_plan() a masque_plan.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
  r <- propose_roles(iris, detect = FALSE)
  f <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
  save_plan(masque_plan(r), f)
  read_plan(f)
}
#> 
#> ── masque_plan (source vocabulary) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Roles: 5 covariate
#> • Conditional: FALSE
#> • Ladder: hierarchy; grain: TRUE
#> • Column names aliased: FALSE
#> • Coordinate pairs: 0
#> • Linked-event specs: 0
#> • Control specs: 0
